== Title vs Remastered qualifier (#597) ==
The printed title is Death Star: Trench. (Remastered) is a wiki qualifier, not part of the card title. Sample with Title = Death Star: Trench: [[SWCCG Wiki:Card date sample/Death Star: Trench remaster]]. == Unchanged Decipher image copy (#597) ==
The Holotable image [[:File:ANH-L-deathstartrench.gif]] is exactly the 490 × 350-pixel rectangle starting at x=3, y=3 in [[:File:ANH-L-deathstartrench-decipher-archive.gif]], the Decipher web image. Decoded RGB comparison found no differing pixels. The excluded area is outer padding and drop shadow; the artwork, frame, lettering, icons, text and ©1996 copyright line are unchanged.<ref>[http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/deathstartrench.gif Death Star: Trench card image], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021214212316/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/deathstartrench.gif Internet Archive], 14 December 2002 (original bytes checked).</ref>

The separate Remastered article and sample therefore redirect to the original card and original date sample, and the unsupported Versions entry is removed. The image files and revision histories are retained. A later distribution copy does not establish a new remake or a new card release date.

The physical scan [[:File:ANH-L-deathstartrench-hires.webp]] reads “each of your starfighters is”; both Decipher's web image and its Holotable crop read “your starfighters are”. This physical-versus-web discrepancy is retained as a separate printing comparison. It does not establish a Players Committee rewrite: the latter wording already appears in Decipher's own archived image.
